summary: Speechmatics grants new accounts $100 in credit (1 credit = $1) usable on speech-to-text in 55+ languages and low-latency text-to-speech, no card required. The Free tier allows 2 concurrent real-time sessions; once the credit is used, add a card to continue on pay-as-you-go.
claim_steps: Sign up at https://portal.speechmatics.com/signup/ — no card required.
$100 in credit is applied to the new account; usable on STT and TTS.
After the credit is consumed, add a card in account settings to continue.
